title: Understanding Anger
subtitle: and How it Affects Your Relationships.
description: Are you tired of being angry all the time? Anger can cause a lot of damage in your relationships, in fact many people who experience anger; face lost relationships, lost jobs and careers and at times, lost freedom because they even get in trouble with authorities. This short course has been an awakening for many people I have taught it too. Now it is available by video in the privacy of your own home.

lessons.title: Understanding Your Anger - Part One
lessons.body: Welcome to Understanding Your Anger and how it affects your relationships. It is a powerful tool to help you understand and manage your anger. Thanks for Downloading. Hope it helps and if you would like some coaching for more personalized help book a discovery call with me.

lessons.title: Understanding Your Anger - Part Two
lessons.body: In the first video I laid a foundation of how Anger and the heart interact and where anger comes from emotionally. In this video I am going to teach on anger and the brain. I will examine the brain science behind anger and how it can be reshaped to help you overcome anger.
